name: GoHighLevel Missed Call Text Back: AI replies and booking

parameters.content:
## 1. Receive a GoHighLevel call
Both native GoHighLevel workflows post here: workflow A with "event": "missed_call" right after it texts the caller, workflow B with "event": "reply" when a tagged contact texts back. The shared secret (Authorization: Bearer, or customData.secret from the standard Webhook action) and the settings are checked before anything else.

parameters.errorMessage: A webhook call arrived without the right shared secret and was ignored. If real GoHighLevel calls land here, check GHL_WEBHOOK_SECRET and the Authorization header (or customData.secret) in both GoHighLevel workflows.
={{ 'Settings are not valid, so the GoHighLevel call was not handled. ' + $('Check Request').first().json.problems.join('. ') + '.' }}

={{ 'A webhook call from GoHighLevel could not be read: ' + $('Check Request').first().json.reason + '. Check the body of the webhook action in the GoHighLevel workflow (see ghl/native-workflows.md).' }}

parameters.content:
## 2. Record the missed call
Workflow A already texted the caller, tagged them and opened the opportunity. Here the conversation state starts fresh (reply count, offered times) and a note with the time goes on the contact. A repeat delivery within 10 minutes is skipped.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Could not add the missed call note to contact ' + $('Check Request').first().json.contactId + ': ' + ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : 'unknown error') + '. The caller still got the text from GoHighLevel. Check the contacts.write scope of GHL_API_KEY.' }}

parameters.content:
## 3. Load the conversation
Loads the contact and the last 20 messages. Then code decides, before any AI: repeat delivery, not in the flow, STOP, emergency words (alert at once), DND, already booked or with a person, the reply cap, and whether it is quiet hours.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Could not load contact ' + $('Check Request').first().json.contactId.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + ' after they texted "' + $('Check Request').first().json.text.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + '", so nobody answered them. ' + ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : '') }}

parameters.content:
## 5. Quiet hours
A message that arrives between QUIET_HOURS_START and QUIET_HOURS_END and is not an emergency or an opt out waits here. When quiet hours end, it is posted back to the webhook as a new run with "held": true, so it is answered with fresh data. If several messages waited, only the newest is answered.

nodes.name: Wait: Quiet Hours
nodes.notes: Resumed runs start from the workflow memory saved when the run began, so nothing after this node may write workflow memory. The replay below starts a fresh run instead.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'reply', held: true, heldKey: $('Build Context').first().json.heldKey, locationId: $env.GHL_LOCATION_ID, contactId: $('Build Context').first().json.contactId, conversationId: $('Build Context').first().json.conversationId, messageId: $('Build Context').first().json.messageId, body: $('Build Context').first().json.text, messageType: 'SMS', direction: 'inbound' }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'A text from ' + String($('Build Context').first().json.name).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + ' (' + $('Build Context').first().json.phone + ') waited through quiet hours but could not be handed back to the workflow: ' + ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : 'unknown error') + '. Answer them by hand. They wrote "' + $('Build Context').first().json.text.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + '". n8n must be able to reach its own webhook URL (set SELF_WEBHOOK_URL if it cannot).' }}

parameters.content:
## 4. Decide
One Claude call with a forced tool call, so the intent, the reply and the reason for the call always come back as clean JSON. No tool call, max_tokens or an outage takes the fallback route: a holding reply and a person. In quiet hours only an emergency or an opt out is acted on; anything else waits.

## 6. Act
Wants a visit: 3 real open times from the GoHighLevel calendar. Picked a time: book it and move the opportunity to the booked stage (an open or lost one is reused, a won one never). STOP: SMS DND, keeping the other DND channels.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ calendarId: $env.GHL_CALENDAR_ID, locationId: $env.GHL_LOCATION_ID, contactId: $('Build Context').first().json.contactId, startTime: $json.slot.start, endTime: $json.slot.end, title: 'Service visit: ' + $('Build Context').first().json.name, appointmentStatus: 'confirmed', description: 'Booked by text after a missed call.' + (($json.callReason || $('Build Context').first().json.knownReason) ? ' Reason: ' + ($json.callReason || $('Build Context').first().json.knownReason) + '.' : ''), toNotify: true }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ pipelineId: $env.GHL_PIPELINE_ID, locationId: $env.GHL_LOCATION_ID, name: $('Build Context').first().json.name + ' (missed call)', pipelineStageId: $env.GHL_BOOKED_STAGE_ID, status: 'open', contactId: $('Build Context').first().json.contactId }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify(String($env.DND_ALL_CHANNELS || '').toLowerCase() === 'true' ? { dnd: true } : { dndSettings: Object.assign({}, $('GHL: Get Contact').first().json.contact.dndSettings || {}, ['active', 'permanent'].includes(((($('GHL: Get Contact').first().json.contact.dndSettings || {}).SMS) || {}).status) ? {} : { SMS: { status: 'active', message: 'Opted out by text reply to the missed call assistant' } }) }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'URGENT: ' + String($('Build Context').first().json.name).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') + ' (' + $('Build Context').first().json.phone + ') asked to stop texts, but GoHighLevel did not accept the DND update. Set DND for SMS by hand now. ' + ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : '') }}

parameters.content:
## 7. Reply and record
One place decides the SMS, the tags, the note and the Slack alert. Then: send the SMS, add the tags, add the note, alert Slack (emergencies always, with a channel mention), and end the run as failed if anything went wrong.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'The Slack alert could not be posted (' + ($json.error && $json.error.message ? $json.error.message : 'unknown error') + '). The alert was: ' + $('Finish Reply').first().json.alert + ($('Finish Reply').first().json.fail ? '\nAlso: ' + $('Finish Reply').first().json.fail : '') }}
